FY-SL6FN78-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 43
Committee: Judiciary Sponsor: Senator Merika Coleman
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 03/16/2026
Senate Bill 43 as introduced proposes a constitutional amendment, which if ratified, would
authorize the Legislature, by general law, to revive any time-barred right or remedy for the
sexual abuse of a minor.
This bill would increase the proclamation expenses of the Governor, paid from the State General
Fund, by an estimated $100,000 for the fiscal year ending September 30, 2027.
